description: This file defines data structures, configurations, and logic for wake word detection and matching, including handling of speech segments and trigger words, with optional speech transcription support.

classes.name: WakeWordSegment
classes.description: Represents a segment of detected wake word or speech, with associated timing and text.

classes.name: WakeWordGateConfig
classes.description: Configuration for wake word detection, including triggers and timing thresholds.

classes.name: WakeWordGateMatch
classes.description: Represents a successful wake word match with relevant timing and command.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Main function to match wake words within a transcript and segments based on configuration.

methods.name: commandText
methods.description: Extracts command text following the trigger end time from segments.

methods.name: matchesTextOnly
methods.description: Checks if given text contains any of the trigger words.

methods.name: stripWake
methods.description: Removes trigger words from the beginning of a text.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Converts speech transcription segments into WakeWordSegment instances.
